title: Polymorphic Components
description: Learn how to create components that can render as different elements.

data.text: **Polymorphic components** can render as different HTML elements or components. They're useful for components that need flexibility in their rendered output.

data.title: Polymorphic
Button Polymorphic
data.content: Button that can render as button or link

terms.definition: Type representing any valid React element type
Extracts props from an element type, excluding ref
Ability to present the same interface for different underlying types

data.title: ComponentPropsWithoutRef
data.text: Use ComponentPropsWithoutRef to get all props of an element without ref, which is handled separately.

data.title: Exercise: Polymorphic Link Component
data.description: Create a Link component that renders as an anchor or React Router Link.
steps: Define LinkProps with as defaulting to 'a'
Accept href and to props depending on as
Test with both anchor and React Router usage
data.expectedOutcome: A polymorphic link that works as both a regular anchor and a router link.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Polymorphic components render as different elements
